text: NVAR replaces the random recurrent reservoir with an explicitly constructed, deterministic feature vector, so its results are reproducible and do not depend on a random seed.
explanation: True. NVAR's features are computed by direct arithmetic on the observed inputs, with no random matrices, so runs are bit-for-bit reproducible — in contrast to ESNs, whose performance varies with the random initialization seed. Determinism/reproducibility is one of NVAR's cited practical advantages.
